Title: Aditya's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aditya - 11 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Hema - 42 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
4. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree

Scene 1: The bathroom - Day

[Aditya stands in the bathroom. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aditya brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Aditya: "Careful!"

[Aditya takes a quick bath.]

Hema: "Really?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Hema stands near him.]

Aditya: "Let's begin."

[Aditya sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Hema: "Aditya, look at this."

[Aditya mops the floor.]

Aditya: "One more time!"

[Aditya irons his school shirt.]

Aditya (excited): "Mom, listen!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Aditya (surprised): "Show me too!"

[Aditya scratches his head.]

Aditya: "This is amazing!"

[Aditya bursts out laughing.]

Hema: "Good job, Aditya!"

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Aditya: "Hey, look at that!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Aditya (softly): "Mom, look at this."

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Hema: "And then?"

Scene 4: The garden - Day

[Aditya stands in the garden. Hema stands near him.]

Aditya: "Mom, look over here."

[Aditya waters the plants.]

Hema: "Let's see."

[Aditya chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Aditya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
